2Data analysis, every panel

What they publish, in full.

The story page shows the five charts that carry the argument. This page keeps every panel, table and paper list behind them. Every confirmed publication from IIT Kharagpur and IIT Roorkee, linked to its faculty, its journals, and the Indian research network around it.

Key findings

    Output

    Output has nearly doubled since 2016.

    Papers per year

    2026 covers January to October (data collected October 2026), so its bars are faded with a dashed outline.

    Quality

    Most journal papers land in Q1 journals.

    Journal quartile mix

    Share of journal papers by the journal's Scimago quartile in the year of publication.

    Top 10 journals

    By number of papers, 2016–2026. IF is the journal's OpenAlex 2-year mean citedness (same formula as the Journal Impact Factor, on OpenAlex data, current value; it runs higher than Clarivate's JIF).

    Conference ranks

    CORE ranking of conference papers. CORE only ranks computing venues, so most conferences have no rank.

    High-impact journals

    Share of journal papers in journals above the IF threshold, per year (IF = OpenAlex 2-year mean citedness).

    Important journals

    Papers in journal groups the field watches closely, 2016–2026. Open a group to see its most cited papers (PRL: all of them).

    Nature journals and their IF

    Every Nature journal with a paper from the two IITs, 2016–2026, with its IF (OpenAlex 2-year mean citedness).

    High-IF papers by team size

    Journal papers by quality and number of authors. Exactly 10 authors has its own column, so every row adds up.

    Research areas

    Share of each institute's papers by research field (OpenAlex primary topic). Click a field to see the subfields inside it.
